INDEPENDENT ROUTE WARNINGS · NMO 249676
GRPRCreERT2-captured excitatory lamina I-II interneuron is an independent NeuroMorpho source record and is not the morphology of mouse.sc.vsx2_hoxa10, another SCI entity, a molecular cluster, or another reconstruction.
The 60 micrometre Sagittal section and source-reported Dendrites Moderate, Axon Incomplete integrity require slice-aware interpretation and cannot establish a complete whole-cell arbor.
The source contains observed type-2 axon nodes but reports Dendrites Moderate, Axon Incomplete; the axon is incomplete and cannot establish a full projection.
The SWC header states that 12 original soma contours were averaged into 12 standardized soma points; those points are not original contour vertices, a membrane, a nucleus, or a volumetric soma segmentation.
The official source reports No Diameter; numeric SWC radius placeholders cannot authorize caliber or a radius-derived surface, so surface mode fails closed.
Identity wording is limited to source_metadata_GRPR_class_and_GRPRCreERT2_capture_line; no direct individual-cell transcript, peptide-abundance, or cross-study molecular identity assay is claimed.
GRPR is the receptor rather than the GRP ligand; Cre capture does not prove functional receptor abundance, and vertical morphology is a source-cohort interpretation rather than an exact deposited-cell annotation.
Missing same-specimen membrane, nucleus, organelle, synapse, receptor, and ultrastructure evidence renders zero internal primitives.
Source-local display scaling creates no atlas registration, laminar placement beyond source metadata, relationship to another route, or prevalence estimate.
